photoTriage.title: Photo Triage
photoTriage.subtitle: Quick keep / drop triage of exported albums
photoTriage.welcomeHint: Scan only walks the directory and pairs files — finishes in seconds; previews are generated on demand and cached.
photoTriage.pickFolderBusy: Waiting for picker… (operate in the Finder window; cancel to go back)
photoTriage.scanGenerating: Generating previews in background {{done}}/{{total}}, triage the ready part now
photoTriage.noRecent: No album has been scanned yet
photoTriage.reselectHint: Back to the welcome screen to pick another photo folder (current progress is saved automatically)
photoTriage.pruneTitle: Verify manifest: deleted items whose trash files are gone, or items with missing originals, are removed from the list
photoTriage.pruneDone: Reset done: removed {{removed}} stale items, kept {{kept}}
photoTriage.emptyDirsArm: ⚠ Click again to confirm deleting {{count}} folders
photoTriage.addFolderHint: Add a target folder: pick any folder on disk in Finder, or create a new one
photoTriage.addFolderSub: It will appear in the bar above the preview. Drag thumbnails or the preview onto a folder card to move items (photo+video paired) there. Any folder on disk works.
photoTriage.pickExisting: Pick an existing folder (anywhere on disk)
photoTriage.alreadyInBar: This folder is already in the bar
photoTriage.folderEmptyHint: （click ＋ on the right to add any folder; drag photos onto it to move）
photoTriage.pickFirst: Select photos first (⌘/Ctrl+click thumbnails), or click one in the left column
photoTriage.selectedAll: Selected {{count}} items: click a folder card, press 1-9, or drag to move them
photoTriage.alreadyTrashed: Items already in Trash cannot be moved
photoTriage.noPreview: Cannot generate preview (original may be corrupt or unsupported)
photoTriage.markAllKeepConfirm: Mark all {{count}} items as Keep? Existing marks will be overwritten.
photoTriage.markAllDropConfirm: Mark all {{count}} items as Drop? Existing marks will be overwritten.
photoTriage.exportHint: Export keep/drop marks (JSON); use the export command to copy original files
photoTriage.exportEmpty: No marks yet (keep or drop are both exportable)
photoTriage.trashEmpty: No items marked Drop yet (unprocessed ones stay untouched). Press D to mark, or use "Drop all".
photoTriage.trashConfirmSub: {{count}} items / {{count2}} files will be moved to Trash (recoverable from Trash). They will no longer exist in their original folders. Review every file path carefully.
photoTriage.trashMoved: Moved {{count}} file(s) to Trash; recoverable from Trash
photoTriage.trashMovedWarn: Moved {{count}} file(s) to Trash; {{count2}} failed (see console)
photoTriage.restored: Restored {{count}} file(s) from Trash and marked as Keep
photoTriage.v2: Mark Keep, auto-advance to next unprocessed
photoTriage.v3: Mark Drop, auto-advance to next unprocessed
photoTriage.v5: Restore current Deleted item from Trash
photoTriage.v10: Group by folder on/off (when on, a group index bar appears along the left edge of the thumbnail area: click a tick to jump to that group; hovering turns it blue and shows the folder name, and ticks still loading also show loaded/total; ticks fill from both ends toward the center as loading progresses — orange = loading, green = fully loaded; the tick of the group at the top of the viewport stays highlighted)
photoTriage.v13: ⌘/Ctrl+click thumbnails to multi-select, Shift+click for range, ⌘/Ctrl+A selects all under current filter; drag onto folder card, click it, or press 1-9 to move paired items
photoTriage.v14: Verify every item: drop deleted items whose trash is gone and items with lost originals
photoTriage.v15: Find completely empty folders under the album (anything counts), check and confirm delete
photoTriage.ffmpegMissing: ffmpeg not installed — videos show a static poster only
photoTriage.splitterHint: Drag to resize thumbnails (double-click to reset)
photoTriage.emptyDirsLoadFailed: Failed to load empty folders; showing the previous result

persistence.recovered: Saved classifications were unreadable. A backup was kept and the defaults were restored.
persistence.newerSchema: Saved classifications were created by a newer Bench version. Editing is disabled to protect them.
persistence.tooLarge: Saved classifications exceed the safety limit. Editing is disabled until the data is reviewed.
